recommended_config:
The maximum-return setup is the dev-selected PRIMARY, C7+KT, run on an Exness swap-free cent account. It was chosen by a dev-only rule and run on validation once. Each item below gives exact values.

1) ACCOUNT
- Use Exness Standard Cent (MT5, HEDGING mode), symbol XAUUSDc.
- Before going live, check that swap long and swap short are both 0 in the symbol specification (Indonesian swap-free status).
- If swap-free cannot be had, stay on HFM Cent. Use the HFM numbers below; the ranking is unchanged.
- No paid VPS paid from the $50 account: $5-12/month ruins it. Use the broker's free VPS or a home PC.
- IB rebates are worth about $0 at $50. Not worth setting up until equity is above about $200.

2) SIZING 'KT' (rolling half-Kelly x pullback-depth tier). It replaces InpRiskPct, the ladder and the drawdown brake.
- R = net profit of each closed position group (profit + swap + commission, the add included) / risk money of the first entry.
- K step:
  - Fewer than 15 closed groups: base = 2%.
  - Otherwise, take x = the last min(n, 60) R values.
  - k = mean(x) / max(sample variance(x), 0.5).
  - base = clamp(0.5 x k, 1%, 6%).
- T step (rsi_depth, measured at the signal bar):
  - Long: rsi_depth = 40 - lowest RSI(14, H1) over the 10 completed H1 bars ending at the signal bar.
  - Short: rsi_depth = highest RSI over the same bars - 60.
  - Multiplier m = 1.5 if rsi_depth <= 1.826; 0.5 if rsi_depth > 4.905; otherwise 1.0.
- Risk = base x m, so 0.5% to 9%.
- Minimum-lot rule: keep InpMaxRiskAtMinLotPct = 3. At $50 with today's ~$73 stops, 0.01 lot already risks 1.47%, so the real floor is about 1.5% until equity is above about $75.
- Start cold (2% for the first 15 groups). Seeding with the backtest's last 60 C7 R values gives about 2.1% on Exness (1.3% on HFM), which is almost the same.

3) TRADE MANAGEMENT 'C7' = W1 + X1 + R2 + T2. Entries, the 2xATR(H4) stop and the 3xATR chandelier trail stay unchanged.
- W1 (weekend hold, longs only):
  - At Friday 20:00 UTC, if a LONG is at least +1.0R in profit (Bid - entry >= 1 x initial stop distance), do not close it.
  - Move SL to max(SL, entry + 0.5R), keep trailing, and close at Tuesday 20:00 UTC.
  - Shorts, and longs below +1R, close at the Friday close as now.
- X1 (extend the 72h cap):
  - At entry + 72h, if open P&L >= 0 and the last completed H4 bar's trend equals the trade direction, move SL to max(SL, entry) (breakeven).
  - Hold until Friday 20:00 UTC. At that point W1 is checked again.
  - Otherwise close as now.
- R2 (one re-entry after a stop-out):
  - Applies after a normal (non-re-entry) trade is stopped out below entry (above entry for shorts).
  - For the next 48h, also accept an RSI(14, H1) cross up through 45 (down through 55 for shorts) in the same direction while the H4 trend agrees.
  - Only one re-entry per stop-out. A re-entry that is stopped out does not arm another.
  - Same time filters as normal entries. The normal 40/60 signal has priority.
- T2 (one Turtle add):
  - At entry, place a buy-stop (sell-stop) at fill +/- 1.0 x ATR(H4) at entry.
  - Volume = max(minimum lot, floor(0.5 x first lots)).
  - When it fills, move both stops to max(SL, add fill - 2.0 x ATR) (mirror for shorts). Stops are never loosened.
  - Total open risk must stay <= 1.5 x the first entry's risk money.
  - Both positions trail and close together.

4) EA SETTINGS
- InpRiskLadder = false.
- InpDDReducePct = 100 (brake OFF). The default brake cuts the primary's 2013-26 result from $10,133 to $226.
- InpDailyLossPct = 20. At 5%, 9 of the 31 re-entries would be blocked.
- InpMaxTradesPerDay = 6, because the add counts as a trade.
- InpHardStopPct = 30 (keep). The primary never hit it from a fresh $50 in any test period. It would have halted in 2 of 13 start years (HFM; 1 of 13 on Exness), against 9 of 13 for fixed 3% and 10 of 13 for the ladder.
- InpFridayClose = true, InpMaxHoldDays = 3 (the W1 and X1 exceptions sit on top).

5) MILESTONES AND WITHDRAWALS
- Change nothing when the account doubles. No milestone rule beat sizing on the system's own recent R. The 5/3/2 ladder and 'withdraw 50% at each 2x' both lose on validation.
- KT's risk does not depend on the equity level, so withdrawals and deposits do not change the risk %. The EA already shifts the hard-stop and peak baselines on balance operations.
- Withdraw only for living money, not as a return lever.

6) STATED RISK (backtest, HFM costs; Exness in brackets)
- Max drawdown 55.5% (56.7%).
- Longest time under water about 5 years (Jan 2018 to Mar 2023), in the single account; every configuration has this.
- Worst single-trade loss -10% of equity. 14% of trades risk more than 6%.
- Block bootstrap, 3 years / 150 trades from $50:
  - Median $93 ($126), P10 $40 ($43), P90 $521 ($821).
  - P(close below the -30% hard stop at some point) 9% (6%).
  - P(ending below $50) 23% (16%).
  - Fixed 3% for comparison: median $63, P10 $32, P(hit -30%) 30%, P(ending below $50) 33%.

7) ROLLOUT ORDER
- Stage 1, the robust core: Exness + brake off + KT + W1 (validation sum $1,438 / 2013-26 $4,695 / max DD 49% on Exness).
- Verify it trade by trade in the MT5 tester against scripts/mm_combined.py.
- Stage 2: add X1, T2 and R2 to complete C7.
- R2 is the weakest piece. If anything is left out, leave out R2. Note that 'C7 without R2' was not validated as a choice.

needs_ea_change:
Changes to mql5/GoldSwingCent.mq5 for C7 + KT. Today the EA has single-position logic, InpRiskPct capped at 5 in OnInit, the ladder and the DD brake.

A) INPUTS AND OnInit
- Add InpKellySizing=true, InpKellyWindow=60, InpKellyFrac=0.5, InpKellyVarFloor=0.5, InpKellyMinPct=1.0, InpKellyMaxPct=6.0, InpKellyWarmPct=2.0, InpKellyMinTrades=15.
- Add InpDepthTiers=true, InpDepthBars=10, InpDepthCutLo=1.826, InpDepthCutHi=4.905, InpDepthMultHi=1.5, InpDepthMultLo=0.5.
- Add InpWeekendHold=true, InpWkMinR=1.0, InpWkLockR=0.5, InpWkHours=96, InpWkLongOnly=true.
- Add InpCapExtend=true, InpExtMinR=0.0, InpExtLockR=0.0, InpExtNeedTrend=true.
- Add InpReentry=true, InpReRsiLevel=45, InpReWindowH=48.
- Add InpTurtleAdd=true, InpAddATR=1.0, InpAddFrac=0.5, InpAddStopATR=2.0, InpMaxGroupRisk=1.5.
- Optional: InpSeedRFile.
- Change defaults: InpDDReducePct=100, InpRiskLadder=false, InpDailyLossPct=20, InpMaxTradesPerDay=6.
- Relax the OnInit check 'InpRiskPct > 5' when InpKellySizing is on: allow InpKellyMaxPct x InpDepthMultHi <= 12.
- Refuse InpTurtleAdd on a netting account: it needs ACCOUNT_MARGIN_MODE_RETAIL_HEDGING.

B) GROUP STATE
- Store GlobalVariables keyed by the FIRST position id at OpenTrade:
  - sl0 = initial stop distance (2xATR).
  - atr0.
  - risk0 = lots x LossPerLot(sl0 + InpRiskBufferUSD).
  - dir.
  - tag (0 = normal, 1 = re-entry).
  - wk_deadline, ext_flag, add_done.
- The add position carries the group id in its order comment ('GSW add <id>') so it can be found again after a restart.
- SelectMyPosition, CloseAll, CloseAllThrottled, UpdatePeak, FloatingPnL and CanOpenNewTrade must treat 'any position OR pending order with InpMagic on _Symbol' as the group.
- CloseAll must also delete the pending add order.

C) R HISTORY
- When the LAST position of a group closes (OnTradeTransaction / OnClosedDeal): R = sum over all deals of the group's positions of (DEAL_PROFIT + DEAL_SWAP + DEAL_COMMISSION), including the IN-deal commissions, divided by risk0.
- Append time, R, dir, tag and a stop-loss flag to Common/Files/GoldSwingCent_R_<login>.csv.
- The stop-loss flag is true when the first position was closed by DEAL_REASON_SL at a price worse than its entry.
- Keep the last InpKellyWindow values in memory, loaded in OnInit, optionally seeded from InpSeedRFile.
- Also keep last_exit_time, last_dir, last_tag and last_sl_loss for R2.

D) SIZING (LotsForRisk)
- Replace baseRisk and the brake with:
  - base = (n < 15) ? 2.0 : clamp(100 x 0.5 x mean(x) / max(var_sample(x), 0.5), 1.0, 6.0), where x = the last min(n, 60) R values;
  - riskPct = base x mult.
- mult comes from CheckEntrySignal:
  - CopyBuffer(g_hRsi, 0, 1, 10, buf), i.e. the signal bar and the 9 completed bars before it.
  - Long: depth = 40 - min(buf). Short: depth = max(buf) - 60. The 40/60 reference is also used for re-entries.
  - mult = 1.5 if depth <= 1.826; 0.5 if depth > 4.905; otherwise 1.0.
- Keep the minimum-lot rule (InpMaxRiskAtMinLotPct=3) and the margin check.
- Do NOT apply InpReducedRiskPct.

E) R2 IN CheckEntrySignal
- Besides the 40/60 cross, if InpReentry is on and all of the following hold, also accept RSI[prev] < 45 <= RSI[now] for longs (RSI[prev] > 55 >= RSI[now] for shorts):
  - last_tag == 0;
  - last_sl_loss is true;
  - TimeCurrent - last_exit_time <= 48h;
  - H4TrendEx == last_dir.
- The direction must be last_dir. Open it with tag 1.
- The normal signal has priority. A tag-1 group never arms another re-entry.
- Apply the same Friday cutoff, no-entry hours and 5-minute delay rules as normal entries.

F) ManagePosition, rewritten for the group
- Trail: the chandelier distance 3 x atr0 from the highest Bid since the FIRST open (lowest Ask for shorts). Apply it to every position of the group; never loosen a stop.
- Friday-close branch (Fri >= 20:00 UTC, or weekend):
  - If InpWeekendHold, the group is long, wk_deadline is unset, and (Bid - open1) >= 1.0 x sl0: set wk_deadline = this Friday 20:00 UTC + 96h, move every SL to max(SL, open1 + 0.5 x sl0), and do not close.
  - While wk_deadline is set, skip the Friday/weekend close and the max-hold close, and CloseAll at wk_deadline (Tuesday 20:00 UTC).
  - Keep the holiday extra-flat closes.
- Max-hold branch (TimeCurrent - open1 >= 72h):
  - If InpCapExtend and ext_flag is unset, open P&L >= 0 (Bid >= open1 for longs, Ask <= open1 for shorts) and H4TrendEx == dir: set ext_flag, move every SL to max(SL, open1), and hold to the Friday 20:00 close, where the W1 test runs again.
  - Otherwise close all.

G) T2 ADD
- Right after the first fill, place a BUY STOP (SELL STOP) at open1 +/- 1.0 x atr0 with volume = max(vmin, floor(0.5 x lots1 / vstep) x vstep) and no SL.
- Reduce the volume so that the open risk to the new stop is <= 1.5 x risk0. If even vmin does not fit, do not place the order.
- On fill (OnTradeTransaction, DEAL_ENTRY_IN of the add): newSL = max(curSL, addFill - 2.0 x atr0) for longs (min for shorts). PositionModify both positions.
- Only one add per group. Delete the pending order when the first position closes.

H) VERIFY BEFORE LIVE
- Run the MT5 tester on Exness XAUUSDc M1 (real ticks) for 2022-2025.
- Compare trade by trade (entry/exit time, R, exit reason, adds, weekend holds) with trades('C7', 'EXN') and the risk % per trade from scripts/mm_combined.py.
caveats:
1) Re-run results.
- All four cluster scripts reproduce their reported numbers exactly: sizing C/B/A/A2, conviction C1-C5, management finals including its engine-equivalence check (603 trades identical, swap-free too), and the account tables.
- I found no look-ahead:
  - The trades never overlap (0 entries before the previous exit, in the EA list and in C7), so R-history policies only see closed trades.
  - rsi_depth uses H1 bars completed at the signal close and dev-only cut points.
  - The weekend-hold, extension and add decisions use the bar-open price at the decision time and completed H4 bars (align_htf_to_m1).
  - Same-bar add-and-stop cases are scored pessimistically.
- Design-level look-ahead: the 5/3/2 ladder (and B and C4 built on it) uses thresholds picked after seeing all data. W1 and X1 came from full-sample quick checks.

2) The references are optimistic.
- mm_sim ignores the EA's -30% halt, the daily-loss limit and the DD brake.
- With the halt modelled, fixed 3% ends dev at $34.84 and halts in 9 of 13 start years; the ladder halts in 10 of 13.

3) The combination's validation is not blind.
- The primary was picked by a dev-only rule that I fixed before running it on validation.
- But I had read every cluster's validation numbers, so the component set had already been filtered by validation: R2 was not offered alone, and the ladder-based options were excluded.

4) The dev figure is inflated by selection.
- Dev $624 vs $60 is the best of 27 combinations of cluster winners, each picked from 29-48 dev combos.
- Validation confirms the ordering (rank 1 of 28; dev/validation Spearman 0.90), not the size.

5) The magnitudes are compounding artifacts.
- $10k (HFM) and $33k (Exness) from $50 over 13 years should not be read as forecasts.
- Sizing neighbours give $2k-10k.
- A realistic 3-year view is the bootstrap: median about $93-126 from $50, P10 about $40-43, P(hitting -30%) 6-9%, P(ending below $50) 16-23%. In a 2013-19-like future: median $75, P(hitting -30%) 14%.

6) It is one regime bet in several layers.
- 57% of the single-account log growth comes from 2022-25, and validation_sum is dominated by that one gold trend.
- K, T2, X1 and W1 all amplify trends.
- In the weak periods the primary's edge over fixed 3% is small in dollars: +$5 in 2020-21, +$7 in 2026.
- Every configuration spent about 5 years under water (Jan 2018 to Mar 2023).
- With regime persistence removed (bootstrap block 10), K alone has a lower median than fixed 3%.

7) R2 is suspect.
- It failed validation alone.
- Post hoc, the stack without R2 (C6+KT) is better in all 3 validation periods (val_sum $2,756 vs $1,964) but much worse on dev.
- R2 is kept only because the protocol picked C7 on dev.

8) T's evidence rests on one validation run (p 0.018). Dev was weak (null p 0.73), and at fixed 3% the effect flips in 2026 (24 trades).

9) Risk per trade.
- Up to 9%. 14% of trades risk more than 6%. The worst single trade was -10% of equity.
- At $50 with 2026 stops (~$73), the minimum lot already risks 1.47%, so the 1% floor and the 0.5x tier do nothing until equity passes about $75.

10) The EA defaults break the result.
- The DD brake turns the primary's $10,133 into $226.
- InpDailyLossPct=5 would block 9 of the 31 re-entries.
- OnInit rejects any risk above 5%.

11) Implementation risk is the biggest practical caveat.
- C7 needs two-position group handling, pending orders, weekend holds and re-entries.
- The backtest assumes an exact port. Verify trade by trade in the MT5 tester first. A staged rollout (KT + W1 first) limits the damage from bugs.

12) Data.
- 2013-2021 are H1 bars only, so intrabar order is approximated (pessimistically).
- 2026 is 24 trades starting 2026-03-26.

13) Broker facts are unverified.
- The Exness XAUUSDc spread (x0.75) and swap-free status are not verified. If swap-free is revoked, use the HFM-cost numbers.
- Exness is not licensed by Bappebti.

14) Housekeeping.
- My only file is /home/user/Trade/scripts/mm_combined.py. Someone else committed it as WIP commit fb0bd4f while I worked; the working copy adds a 10-line docstring section on top. I ran no git commands that change state.
- My first background run accidentally wrote two log files to /. I moved them to the scratchpad; nothing is left there.
- Full outputs are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Trade/e03777fa-c2bc-5e97-a6e8-e6745e2e9419/scratchpad/synth/ (combined_final.txt, sizing.txt, conviction.txt, mgmt_final.txt, account.txt).
